description.narrative:
This training will support Ovibashi Karmi Unnayan Program (OKUP), who work closely with children and vulnerable adults (especially women), to have the capacity to safeguard children and vulnerable adults (especially women), as well as identifying protection risks and issues for boys and girls in all stages of the programme cycle, and addressing these as far as possible. The training will also help set out the foundations for developing a suitable and contextually relevant organisational Child Protection Policy for OKUP.
Objectives: At the end of the training, participants will • Have increased understanding of child protection issues – how to engage with children, how to recognise signs of abuse, deal with issues sensitively and how to report child protection issues. • Are clear about their role in safeguarding children and vulnerable adults, and are able to apply their understanding in the context of their work • Have committed to an action plan which lays out a clear process to develop a child protection policy within the organisation
Outputs: The Consultant will provide a brief report (2-3 pages) to CAFOD including; • an overview of the training • participants’ review of the training with appropriate data, suggestions for change and lessons learnt. • A clear a realistic action plan for OKUP to develop a comprehensive and realistic Child Protection Policy including the responsibilities for taking this work forward.
The training will take place over two days in June 2016 at the OKUP office in Dhaka. Participants will be a combination of senior management and field level staff. The workshop will be facilitated by a National Consultant with details knowledge of Child Protection issues in Bangladesh.
